title: Chapter 9
text: ∫ startled into life like fire in grievous deity my cat walks around he walks around and around with electric tail and push-button eyes he is alive and plush and final as a plum tree neither of us understands cathedrals or the man outside watering his lawn if I were all the man that he is cat— if there were men like this the world could begin he leaps up on the couch and walks through porticoes of my admiration.
